text: Completed in 44dce9f. Shared TextMetrics keeps its size-only source-compatible contract and deterministic estimate while adding family-aware TextStyle overloads; Theme propagates the exact GraphicParams families and point sizes into LayoutPolicy. Added opt-in Java2DTextMetrics and CanvasTextMetrics with explicit missing-family fallbacks, documented JavaFX reuse, and tests for family/size propagation, fallback, estimator comparison, and layout overflow. Detached commit matrix passed warning-free: graphics JVM 210, graphics JS 210, SVG JVM 24, SVG JS 21, Canvas JS 12, Java2D JVM 11, JavaFX JVM 7.
